study_setting.evidence_quote: 92 from Hospital Universitario La Paz, a third-level hospital in the northern area of the city of Madrid. Then, 35 had been obtained from 18 different hospital wards between 2012 and 2014, 32 from a surgical ward (Vascular Surgery) between 2012 and 2015 and 25 from a medical ward (Nephrology) in the same time period... Five isolates were obtained from Hospital Universitario Doce de Octubre, a third-level hospital in the southern part of Madrid.

amr_study.evidence_quote: In total, 97 isolates of OXA-48-producing K. pneumoniae belonging to ST11 (Kp-OXA-ST11) were selected among those obtained from clinical and surveillance samples (rectal swabs) following the routine procedures of the Clinical Microbiology Departments of HULP and Hospital Universitario Doce de Octubre (H12O). One isolate per patient was selected.

amr_target.evidence_quote: OXA-48-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae (Kp-OXA) are multidrug-resistant pathogens that have spread through the Mediterranean region during the last decade... The blaOXA-48 gene was located in plasmid p65L.

amr_method.evidence_quote: 97 isolates of OXA-48-producing K. pneumoniae belonging to ST11 were selected among those obtained from clinical and surveillance samples... Sequence type identification was done by clone-specific PCR [14] in HULP, and by Multi-Locus Sequence Typing (MLST) [15] in H12O.

cohort_age.evidence_quote: The median age of Kp-OXA colonized patients in HULP during the study period was around 70 years [3, 30]... the Kp11-30, Kp11-31 and Kp11-32 isolates were obtained in a paediatric unit over a period of 6 months.

amr_method.evidence_quote: Isolates were selected on the basis of their geographic and temporal distributions, KPC variants, and Tn4401 patterns.

coverage_basis: The paper states 'All of the genomes determined in this study are available at NCBI under BioProject no. PRJNA259658.' ENA shows 73 total samples for this accession, all classified as Klebsiella (ena_taxon_samples = ena_total_samples = 73) due to large-scale post-publication taxonomic reclassification of former Enterobacter cloacae complex members (e.g. E. aerogenes → K. aerogenes, E. hormaechei → K. hormaechei, E. xiangfangensis → K. xiangfangensis). The paper covers all 73 deposited samples. The discrepancy between 97 clinical isolates stated in the paper and 73 in ENA is unexplained (possibly type strains, pre-existing GenBank entries, or failed depositions), but coverage of the ENA-deposited Klebsiella records is 73/73 = 100%.

notes: TAXON CONTEXT: This BioProject (PRJNA259658) is titled 'KPC Enterobacter sp.' and the paper is about Enterobacter spp., but ENA now classifies all 73 deposited samples as Klebsiella due to post-publication taxonomic reclassification (E. aerogenes → K. aerogenes; E. hormaechei → K. hormaechei; E. xiangfangensis → K. xiangfangensis, etc.). The paper used pre-reclassification taxonomy. SIZING: Article states 97 clinical isolates + 6 type strains = 103, but only 73 appear in ENA; the 30-sample gap is unexplained (type strains may be excluded, some may have pre-existing accessions, or some were not linked). This may be Case B (multi-accession study), but the paper explicitly states all genomes are under PRJNA259658. AMR_STUDY: 23/97 isolates were carbapenem-susceptible and deliberately included for phylogenetic comparison alongside 66 KPC-positive and 2 NDM-positive isolates, fitting the 'mixed' definition. AMR_METHOD: Isolates were selected by KPC gene variant and Tn4401 pattern (molecular/genotypic criteria), supporting pcr_gene_presence; phenotypic carbapenem resistance was also measured by broth microdilution but was not the primary selection gate.

notes: SIZING: ENA shows 50 Klebsiella taxon samples = 50 total samples. The EBI description lists 25 PF Klebsiella + 24 TC Klebsiella (~49-50), matching ENA. E. coli samples (25 PF + 21 TC per EBI description) are apparently absent from this accession (ena_total=ena_taxon=50). STUDY TYPE: Classified experimental_evolution because ~50% of deposited Klebsiella are TC strains — created by deliberate conjugative introduction of pOXA-48 into clinical strains and then sequenced. This is a deliberate genetic alteration of strains followed by sequencing, meeting the rubric definition. Study is excluded from cohort. AMR_STUDY: All deposited Klebsiella meet AMR criteria — PF strains are ESBL-producing (positively screened via the ESBL/CPE surveillance programme); TC strains carry pOXA-48 (carbapenemase). AMR_TARGET: third_gen_cephalosporin because the primary selection criterion governing which Klebsiella entered the deposited set was ESBL production (3GC resistance); the PF strains are explicitly noted as 'not carbapenem-resistant'; pOXA-48 carbapenem resistance in TC strains was experimentally introduced rather than used as the original selection criterion. AMR_METHOD: ast_result inferred from standard clinical ESBL surveillance phenotypic screening protocol (Hernandez-Garcia 2018); TC strains additionally selected on ertapenem-containing agar. ISOLATION_SOURCE/HOST: Not backfillable for whole project — PF strains come from gut microbiota (rectal/stool) of hospitalized patients (host=human, source=rectal swab/stool), but TC strains are lab-created artifacts with no natural specimen or host. COLLECTION_DATE: R-GNOSIS surveillance window March 2014–March 2016 (~2 years, midpoint ~2015-03) applies only to PF strains; TC strains were created in the lab at a later time with no clinical collection date.

The entire deposited set consists of in vitro-evolved derivatives of a single XDR K. pneumoniae ST258 clinical isolate (20_GR_12) subjected to 20-day serial passage under increasing concentrations of colistin, polymyxin B, or octapeptin C4 to deliberately drive resistance mutations — a textbook experimental-evolution design. ENA count of 50 is fully accounted for: 2 initial-isolate colonies + 4 colonies × 4 replicates × 3 treatment groups = 50; paper coverage fraction = 50/50 = 1.0. Because the deposited sequences are lab-evolved in vitro strains rather than clinical or environmental isolates collected from any setting, study_setting, amr_study, cohort_age, and all backfill fields are not applicable. The original clinical isolate (20_GR_12) was sourced from Hygeia General Hospital, Athens, Greece, but that provenance applies only to the parental strain, not to the 48 evolved derivatives that constitute the bulk of the deposit.
